nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.

Public token symbol string, set to 'MGT' in the MingToken constructor.

Public token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account balances; written by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping of allowances (owner => spender => amount) written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.

Overflow-checked multiplication helper.

Owned() constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner to the supplied address.
Accepts ownership when msg.sender == newOwner; emits OwnershipTransferred and clears newOwner.

Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.

edges.reason: Owned() constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner (msg.sender == owner).
Parameter 'to' is the transfer recipient.
Parameter 'tokens' is the transfer amount.
'tokens' is passed to safeSub for the sender balance.
'tokens' is passed to safeAdd for the recipient balance.
safeSub return value assigned to balances[msg.sender].
safeAdd return value assigned to balances[to].
Parameter 'spender' indexes the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'tokens' is the approved amount stored in allowed.
Parameter 'from' is the source account and allowance owner.
Parameter 'to' is the destination account.
Parameter 'tokens' is the amount moved in transferFrom.
'tokens' is passed to safeSub for both balance and allowance.
Parameter 'spender' selects the externally called contract.
Parameter 'tokens' becomes the allowance and call argument.
Parameter 'data' is forwarded verbatim into receiveApproval.
Parameter '_newOwner' is stored into newOwner.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' is cast to ERC20Interface and called externally.
Parameter 'tokens' is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' indexes the balances mapping.
Parameters index allowed[tokenOwner][spender] in allowance().
transfer invokes safeSub for the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs an external call to attacker-controlled spender.receiveApproval, allowing re-entrant execution before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary, untrusted token contract, enabling reentrant callbacks into this contract.
totalSupply() performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
owner is passed as the recipient of the external ERC20 transfer, leaking the privileged address to callee code.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
